reports.complexity: Moderate. The backend already has strict per-request and three-page bounds, but truthful availability requires knowing compatible unique results ahead of the click and coordinating lookahead, buffering, deduplication, errors, and UI state.
evidence: Packet objective reports owner live scan on 2026-11-08: US 9 compatible catalog choices across pages 1+5+3; FR 6 across 5+0+1; JP 1 across 1+0+0. These are compatible catalog counts, not evidence of audible playback, and were supplied in the triage packet rather than independently probed here.
Packet reports additional live counts for 2026-11-08: GB 6, CA 2, DE 1, ES 1, IT 5. With US, FR, and JP this gives eight countries; these are catalog choices, not playback evidence.

src/station-list.ts:102 advertises More whenever the current provider page searched 50 rows, even when later provider pages contain no additional compatible choices; this matches the reported FR and JP empty/duplicate-only continuation behavior.

src/discovery.ts:84-119 bounds each request to one 50-row provider page, pages 0 through 2, and at most 10 compatible stations per response; provider row counts do not establish that any later unique compatible station exists.
Current UI request flow in src/player.ts only fetches a continuation after the user clicks More, so it has no knowledge of additional compatible choices before advertising that control.

The existing automated coverage exercises page offsets and UI continuity, but the current station-list tests encode the searchedCount-based More rule and do not demonstrate a genuine live paginated country with additional compatible rows.
reports.open_questions: Spec should define when the bounded lookahead runs (for example, background scan after initial results versus an explicit loading state), how buffered choices are revealed, and how an inconclusive provider failure is represented without falsely claiming exhaustion. Preserve the existing maximum of three 50-row pages and 30 choices unless the owner explicitly changes those bounds. The supplied live evidence identifies US as a pagination test country; verify that a dated live regression confirms a genuine additional compatible result beyond the first page. Keep host QA gaps BLOCKED at verification.
reports.relevant_code: src/station-list.ts controls canMore and currently sets it from searchedCount === 50, pageIndex < 2, and rows.length < 30. src/discovery.ts fetches one provider page of 50 per invocation, filters rows to unique compatible MP3 streams, caps each result at 10, and rejects pageIndex above 2. src/player.ts requests the next page only after More is clicked. test/station-list.test.js and test/ui-harness.js cover paging, deduplication, selection continuity, request failures, and stale responses; test/discovery.test.js covers provider offsets and bounds.
reports.risks: A speculative continuation scan can add provider latency and fail after initial results; failures must remain distinguishable from confirmed exhaustion. Buffering must not expose duplicate IDs or stream URLs, exceed 150 scanned provider rows or 30 displayed choices, interrupt selected/playing continuity, or allow stale country responses to mutate current state. Keep finite stream validation and the neutral Studio UI. Counts may shift between provider page requests. Host checks remain required; catalog eligibility does not establish audible playback.
